source.title: Ashenvale Mission XII: Dream-Infused Dragonscale
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Bough Shadow and collect Dream-Infused Dragonscale from dragonkin within the Nightmare Incursions. We can harness its magic to reverse the damage. You will need the assistance of a skinner.
source.objective: Gather 10 Dream-Infused Dragonscale in the Ashenvale Nightmare Incursions and return to Field Captain Hannalah.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
